description: This class, TableReader, is responsible for parsing XML data related to Excel table components (like styles, columns, filters) and integrating this information into the worksheet. It handles reading table properties, styles, filters, and columns from the XML and applying them to the Spreadsheet's table objects.

classes.name: TableReader
classes.description: Handles reading and parsing of XML data to populate a spreadsheet table, including styles, filters, columns, and other table properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes TableReader with a worksheet and corresponding XML data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Main method invoked to load the table data into the worksheet, after parsing XML.

methods.name: readTable
methods.description: Reads table attributes and details from the provided XML, creating and configuring a Table object.

methods.name: readTableAutoFilter
methods.description: Reads auto filter settings from the XML and applies them to the table.

methods.name: readTableColumns
methods.description: Reads columns definitions from the XML and sets properties like totals row labels and formulas.

methods.name: readTableStyle
methods.description: Reads and applies style information to the table based on XML data.
